title: Credit Builder Accounts Goodwill Credit: Fee Credited, Refusals and Amount
content:
The goodwill credit on a Credit Builder Accounts late fee is the base goodwill share of the late fee, rounded to the cent. The base goodwill share is 0.2, that is 20 percent.

## The fee credited

The goodwill credit applies to the account's most recent late fee; when two late fees were charged on the same day, the one booked first counts as the most recent.

## When nothing is granted

The goodwill credit is not granted, and nothing is booked, when the account has no late fee, when its most recent late fee already carries a fee waiver or a fee payment, when the plan's courtesy waivers have all been granted on the account in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a waiver dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), when the request comes more than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date (counted in calendar days from the day after it, a request on the last day being in time), or when the credit comes to 0.00.

- The courtesy waivers counted are the account's fee waiver entries with the courtesy basis; the plan's number is 1 per 12 months on the Credit Builder 600, 1000, 1200 and 1800 Plans and 2 on the Credit Builder 2400 and 3000 Plans.
- The fee waiver request window is 60 calendar days on every plan; the request is made today, and the fee's assessment date is the date of its late-fee entry.

## The amount

The goodwill share is applied to the late fee; a goodwill share is never more than 100 percent (a share of 1.0). The credit is rounded to the nearest cent once, a half cent or more rounding up, and it is never more than the late fee.

## Hypothetical cases (late fee 12.50 assessed 1 March)

| Request date | Courtesy waivers in the 12 months (plan allows 1) | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 30 April (60th day) | none | 20 percent of 12.50, that is 2.50 |
| 1 May (61st day) | none | not granted: outside the request window |
| 10 March | one, dated today | not granted: the plan's courtesy waiver is used |
